fusions.name: Staghorn Reach
fusions.desc: Jabs branching fingers at one enemy for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Branching Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a reef 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 25 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crust of Lime
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 18% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Built by Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
